name: carrier-claim
title: Freight invoice credit request
for_each: select id, code from disputes where status in ('open', 'part_credited') order by code

sections.title: Request
sections.sql: select d.code as our_reference, c.name as carrier, c.account_no as account, i.invoice_no as invoice, i.invoice_date, d.raised_on as raised, i.currency, d.claimed_cents as credit_requested_cents, d.credited_cents as credited_so_far_cents from disputes d join carriers c on c.id = d.carrier_id join invoices i on i.id = d.invoice_id where d.id = $1

sections.title: Lines that do not match the agreed rates
sections.sql: select coalesce(l.connote, 'invoice') as connote, f.detail as reason, i.currency, f.billed_cents, f.expected_cents as agreed_cents, f.variance_cents as difference_cents from findings f join invoices i on i.id = f.invoice_id left join invoice_lines l on l.id = f.invoice_line_id where f.dispute_id = $1 order by l.line_no
sections.note: Agreed amounts come from the rate card, fuel levy and surcharge schedule in force on the ship date. Please issue a credit note quoting our reference.

name: invoice-audit
title: Freight invoice audit report
for_each: select id, invoice_no from invoices where audited_at is not null order by invoice_date

sections.title: Invoice
sections.sql: select a.invoice_no as invoice, a.carrier, a.invoice_date, a.due_date, a.status, a.currency, a.billed_cents, a.expected_cents, a.variance_cents from invoice_audit a where a.id = $1

sections.title: Lines checked
sections.sql: select l.line_no as line, l.connote, l.kind, l.charge_code as code, i.currency, l.amount_cents as billed_cents, l.expected_cents from invoice_lines l join invoices i on i.id = l.invoice_id where l.invoice_id = $1 order by l.line_no

sections.title: Findings and decisions
sections.sql: select f.rule as check_failed, f.detail, i.currency, f.variance_cents, f.decision, coalesce(f.decided_by, '') as decided_by from findings f join invoices i on i.id = f.invoice_id where f.invoice_id = $1 order by f.rule
sections.note: Prepared for approval. Approving records a decision here; nothing is paid from this system.
